design_rationale:
WORKLOG task 0 (workflow task) — difficulty dnd_billing_desk, M=2.
[Step 0 scope snapshot] Occupied before this task: nothing. This task claims dnd_ext_final_detention_charge, dnd_ext_final_demurrage_charge, dnd_ext_goodwill_waiver_amount, the single workflow dnd_wf_combined_record_closeout and the tools book_detention_invoice_dba94f21, book_demurrage_invoice_a2ad21e7, grant_goodwill_waiver_e03c98b1, pay_dnd_balance_a831ef2f (user), settle_dnd_record_d9ada3ba. Reserved headroom for task 1 (independent and load-bearing): the dispute and late-invoice space of dnd_invoice_dispute — lodging an overcharge dispute (the billed party's own act), deciding it with a dispute credit, and clearing an invoice issued after its deadline — with its own tools and a DG (dangerous_goods) world, none of which this task touches. The workflow is claimed here, so task 1 needs no workflow room.
[Why a good test] The customer asks for two surface things: a goodwill gesture on the demurrage of one reefer container (the port days before loading) and to pay off whatever is owed on it today by card. She never mentions a bill or invoice. The scored values are hidden behind a chain the agent must read out of the rules: no invoice exists yet (record clock_stopped), so goodwill cannot be computed until the demurrage row is booked ('computed only on a demurrage invoice row already booked on the record'); the demurrage row on a combined export clock continues its slab count from the chargeable_days of the detention row, so the detention row must be booked first; the goodwill base is capped by a recomputation of the demurrage row and scaled by the product's own percent and cap; and the booking's cargo_type (reefer) decides reefer versus dry class and the absence of the dangerous-goods uplift. Difficulty = slab arithmetic across a merged clock (multi-factor) x ledger reads (detention row chargeable_days, goodwill history across three records for the quota) x branches (combined vs separate, import vs export, reefer/non-operating-reefer/dry class, DG uplift, pct/cap). No near-synonym tools exist: each tool realises a distinct base event.
[Long and broad] Depth: surface goal -> final invoice owed on a stopped record (dnd_invoicing) -> detention row first (P_det) -> demurrage row with slab offset (P_dem) -> goodwill on the booked demurrage row (P_gw) -> card payment of the resulting balance -> settlement at 0.00; the owner=user step is the card payment, which only the billed party can make. Breadth: recorded dates on the record, product parameters of AHL Combined Free Time 14 (free 14, slabs 5/5/10, reefer rates, pct 15, cap 500, quota 2, window 45), the booking cargo_type, the ledger rows of the target record, and the goodwill waivers of the two other records (2026-04-20 inside the trailing 365 days, 2025-03-06 outside).
[Policies, lineage, overwrites] P_det and P_dem refine dnd_invoicing (the only base policy governing dnd_detention_invoiced / dnd_demurrage_invoiced) and cite dnd_clock_rules as clock lineage; they inherit the invoice deadline, the stopped-record state gate, the minimum-invoice and one-row-per-type rules. Both declare one overwrite of dnd_invoicing 'Each day is billed at the rate of its clock type, slab and the rate class of the container given by equipment_class_map', replaced by the booking-cargo rule (reefer class only when the booking has cargo_type reefer; a non-operating reefer bills at dry rates). P_dem adds the ordering sentence for export records under combined (the detention row is booked first and the export demurrage slab count continues after the booked detention row's chargeable_days), declared as its second overwrite of dnd_invoicing's 'the slab position of a day is counted across the whole sequence of chargeable days'; on a combined import record the demurrage slab count starts at the first chargeable day and P_dem sets no booking order, because neither row's figure depends on the other there. P_gw refines dnd_goodwill_waiver (+ dnd_invoice_dispute, both govern dnd_charge_waived) and overwrites its amount sentence: goodwill = pct of the goodwill base = min(open after credits, recomputed row) less the DG uplift share, capped, floored to the cent at the end; the quota, window and one-per-row gates stay inherited, and the rule states outright that a goodwill waiver, like a dispute credit, is booked only on a record whose status is invoiced (base credit_on_invoiced_record, whose applies_to already covers dnd_charge_waived). Triggers: P_det/P_dem state_due (a stopped record owes its final invoice with nobody calling), P_gw on_request.
[Base-invariant card] Step 6/8 (dnd_invoicing): invoice_deadline — anchor dnd_free_time.clock_stopped_date 2026-09-04, duration variants.invoice_issue_deadline_days 30, calendar days, not_after, inclusive: deadline 2026-10-04, booking 2026-09-14 satisfied (2026-10-05 would fail); invoice_on_stopped_record — status clock_stopped at opening (initial_state.dnd_free_time.6e0cd4f6-6c7e-4e68-9724-2c062001df94.status). Step 10: credit_on_invoiced_record — status invoiced set by action 6 (prior_step:6); goodwill_quota — goodwill rows of customer e26efb8b-2c83-48e2-8ea7-51142fb6b374: 3bb900f8-d584-4689-ae51-1f9e4b9da852 2026-04-20 inside 2025-09-15..2026-09-14, 2a7125c9-0822-44e9-8d68-46b743861580 2025-03-06 outside, count 1 < goodwill_waivers_per_365d 2 of AHL Combined Free Time 14; goodwill_window — anchor = event_date of the row booked at action 8 (2026-09-14) + 45 days = 2026-10-29 inclusive; one_goodwill_per_invoice — no waiver references the new row. Step 12 (dnd_payment): pay_invoiced_record by prior_step:6; reference_once — AHLU26VLC318457 appears on no ledger row of the record (the only row, extension fee b1c503f3-4b44-4c1e-b8e2-64669180501c, has an empty reference). Step 14: dnd_invoicing and dnd_payment have no gate on dnd_settled (policy_scope).
[Business-object card] Target record 6e0cd4f6-6c7e-4e68-9724-2c062001df94 = container AHLU3184257 on booking dc1e6a7b-412f-4b8f-996c-e215141c23d4 (AHLU26VLC318457, cargo_type reefer, 40RH). Included rows: the record's recorded dates and product; the extension fee row b1c503f3-4b44-4c1e-b8e2-64669180501c (245.00, stays in the balance and is paid with the invoice); the detention row created at action 6 (its chargeable_days feed the demurrage slab offset); the demurrage row created at action 8 (the object of the goodwill, referenced by id dle_706acdb6de1a). Excluded: the two settled records 4e0108b0-349f-4291-8c65-9ea5128143ba and 8d21a1ad-ae6d-41a2-aa46-891ffa77be46 and their invoice/payment rows (other containers; read only for the goodwill quota), and the detention row as goodwill object (the customer asks goodwill on the port days before loading, 'and on nothing else', which are the demurrage days, and the rule grants demurrage goodwill on the demurrage row).
[Seed design] Customer with 3 export records under 3 bookings. R0 opened 2026-08-07 on AHL Tariff Free Time (no contract on the booking) and was upgraded to AHL Combined Free Time 14 on 2026-08-12, while its Tariff export detention clock from pickup 2026-08-10 was still inside the 5 free days 2026-08-11..2026-08-15 (free_time_running, as base dnd_free_time_upgrade requires); it is now clock_stopped, never invoiced, balance = extension fee 245.00. R1 (Extension 7, upgraded 2026-03-10 inside Tariff free days 03-07..03-11) and R2 (Extension 3, upgraded 2025-02-03 inside Tariff free days 02-01..02-05) are settled with coherent arithmetic (3 dry slab-1 days x 85.00 = 255.00, goodwill 10% = 25.50, payment = fee + invoice - goodwill). Their goodwill rows are dated 2026-04-20 and 2025-03-06: each was within its product's quota when granted (R2: none before it; R1: the 2025-03-06 row is outside the 365 days ending 2026-04-20, count 0 < 1), and today they make the trailing-365-day count a real count (1, not 2). No row is unsettled except R0's obligation, which this task discharges; no base automatic clause is left pending (R0's deadline is 2026-10-04).
[Problem-tree card] Root dnd_ext_goodwill_waiver_amount (customer's goodwill ask). Edge 1: root -> dnd_ext_final_demurrage_charge, value_input on invoiced_amount; condition 'Goodwill on a record's demurrage charges is computed only on a demurrage invoice row already booked on that record.'; policy_source = first sentence of P_gw rule; resolved by book_demurrage_invoice_a2ad21e7; false at opening: record status clock_stopped and its only ledger row is the extension fee. Edge 2: dnd_ext_final_demurrage_charge -> dnd_ext_final_detention_charge, value_input on slab_offset; condition 'When an export record's demurrage and detention run on one merged clock, its detention row is booked before its demurrage row.'; false at opening: combined export record with no detention row. Topological order: detention, demurrage, goodwill (a chain, no parallel edge). Deletion sensitivity (dnd_verify.py, gate sandbox): skip detention -> demurrage 975.00 instead of 1445.00 and goodwill 146.25 instead of 216.75; skip demurrage -> goodwill 0.00 instead of 216.75. user_scenario asks only for goodwill on the demurrage and to pay off what is owed; it never mentions a bill, an invoice line, detention, an order of booking or slabs, and its single line about work on the record is passive and names nothing ('If the agent says that something has to be done on the record first, you let the agent go ahead without asking for details'). Tools never check prerequisites (only a missing record returns Error).
[Zero-wait causal card] s0 detention row: needs recorded pickup/gate-in/loading dates and clock_stopped status (initial_state_preexisting, dnd_free_time row). s1 demurrage row: needs the same dates (initial_state_preexisting) and the detention row's chargeable_days 5 (prior_synchronous_tool_effect: action 6 created the ledger row). s2 goodwill: needs the demurrage row id and amount (prior_synchronous_tool_effect of action 8), the goodwill history (initial_state_preexisting) and the customer's request (current_user_input). s3 card payment: the customer's own synchronous act in the call (current_user_input) for the balance left by actions 6/8/10 (prior_synchronous_tool_effect); no clearing is relied on — s4 only needs balance 0.00, which the payment booking itself produces. s4 settle: needs balance 0.00 from s3. No step waits for a movement, a review, a batch or the passage of time; loading happened before the call.
[Persona] Marisol Ferrándiz Oliva, brisk export coordinator. Volunteers only the root and its closure: goodwill on the demurrage (the port days before loading, nothing else) and paying off whatever is owed today by card; the container and booking to locate it. Only when asked: phone +34963384152 and customer code AHL-ES-318604 (email as third), vague movement dates deferring to the records, payment method, and 'no' to goodwill on any other charge. Passive: lets the agent do whatever it says must be done on the record first (names nothing), accepts the goodwill figure or its refusal, pays exactly the amount the agent states once the payment is handed to her, quoting AHLU26VLC318457, and ends when told the record is settled. She knows no amount and never corrects the agent. Her last reaction answers the last gold action (settlement) and asks for nothing further.
[Traps] (1) Booking the demurrage row first or restarting its slab count at 1 gives 975.00. (2) Treating the 40RH as dry (ignoring the reefer booking) gives 325.00 / 910.00. (3) Counting both historical goodwill waivers (2) against the quota of 2 wrongly refuses goodwill; the 2025-03-06 row is outside the trailing 365 days. (4) Using the Extension 7 or Tariff goodwill figures instead of the record's current product (Combined Free Time 14: 15%, cap 500). (5) Granting goodwill on the detention row or on the whole balance including the extension fee. (6) Taking the payment before the goodwill, or paying the pre-goodwill balance 2290.00.
[Standard solution] find_customers(phone) -> verify(phone, code) -> find_dnd_free_time(customer) -> find_bookings(customer) -> find_dnd_ledger(customer) -> detention row 5 days 2026-08-25..2026-08-29 USD 600.00 -> demurrage row 6 days 2026-08-30..2026-09-04 USD 1445.00 -> goodwill 216.75 on dle_706acdb6de1a -> customer card payment 2073.25 ref AHLU26VLC318457 -> settle. Arithmetic: merged clock 2026-08-10..2026-09-04 = 25 days, free 14, gate-in boundary day 19; detention = 19-14 = 5 days slab 1 at 120.00; demurrage = 25-19 = 6 days at positions 6..11: 5 x 225.00 + 1 x 320.00; goodwill = 15% x min(1445.00, 1445.00) = 216.75 < 500; balance 245.00 + 600.00 + 1445.00 - 216.75 = 2073.25.
[Verification run] Commands (repo root): .venv/bin/python scratchpad/dnd_desk/dnd_verify.py 0 (replays gold with the real tools and evaluates each compute with the gate sandbox) -> 'dnd_ext_final_detention_charge handling-time 600.0 expected 600.0 cross-off 325.0', 'dnd_ext_final_demurrage_charge handling-time 1445.0 expected 1445.0 cross-off 910.0', 'dnd_ext_goodwill_waiver_amount handling-time 216.75 expected 216.75 cross-off 136.5', 'skip dnd_ext_final_demurrage_charge -> goodwill = 0.0', 'skip dnd_ext_final_detention_charge -> demurrage = 975.0', goodwill with detention skipped 146.25, terminal record status settled, balance 0.0. Per-task gates: check_extended --task 0 EXTENDED OK; check_task_tools TASK TOOL CONTRACT OK; replay_tasks REPLAY OK (15 actions, closure 16 = init 16); check_solvability SOLVABILITY OK (5 calls, 12 base gates); check_compute COMPUTE OK; check_grounding GROUNDING OK; check_cross_fire SCOPE OK.
[Closure] set(workflow computed_by) = set(computations.policy_id) = charter_scope.extended_policies = required_documents = [P_det, P_dem, P_gw]; GT task-tool sequence equals the five workflow steps in tool/owner/order; dataflow s1->s2 binds the demurrage row's dnd_event_id to reference_event_id (goodwill_window and one_goodwill_per_invoice correlation). solvability_contract registers each call's base gates with pre-write evidence and every workflow step's requires_external_wait false.
[Draft recomputation from the visible context] Masking compute/expected/GT: the published P_det/P_dem/P_gw prose plus the record (combined, export, dates), the booking (reefer) and the product table give: merged clock 25 days; detention days are those up to and including gate-in -> 5; demurrage 6; detention row first; demurrage slab count continues after 5; reefer rates; goodwill 15% of min(open, recomputed), cap 500, floor -> 600.00 / 1445.00 / 216.75, and the balance the customer pays is read from the receipt/record, 2073.25. Same as gold.

It ends with the record settled and nothing owed on it.' The export and both-lines conditions are kept because the detention-first step order holds only on a merged export clock and the detention step books a row only when detention days are chargeable; this task's record still falls inside the class. Each part's own condition stays in the policy it rests on: P_det and P_dem book a row only for days beyond free time ('A record with no detention day beyond free time gets no detention row.' / 'A record with no demurrage day beyond free time gets no demurrage row.'), and P_dem's demurrage slab count counts none when the record carries no detention row; P_gw grants goodwill only at the billed party's request and only on a demurrage invoice row already booked; dnd_payment books the billed party's own remittance up to the balance and settles the record when the balance reaches 0.00. user_scenario: You are Marisol Ferrándiz Oliva, export logistics coordinator at Huerta Levante Exportaciones S.L., a citrus and persimmon grower-exporter in Valencia. You are calling Aurelia Hanse Line about one reefer container, AHLU3184257, that went out of Valencia on booking AHLU26VLC318457 and sailed in early September. You speak briskly and in an organised way, a little apologetic about the overrun but not defensive, and you open with two things. First, the loaded box sat at the port terminal for several days waiting for the ship, and you would like to ask for a goodwill gesture on the demurrage, meaning those port days, and on nothing else. Second, you want to pay off whatever your company owes on this container today, so that the file is closed before your month-end audit. You do not know any of the amounts, rates or day counts and you never guess them; if asked what you think you owe, you say you have no figure and that is why you are calling. When the agent asks you to confirm who you are, you give the registered phone number +34963384152 and the customer code AHL-ES-318604; if a third detail is wanted you also give the email m.ferrandiz@huertalevante.es. If asked about the movement dates, you only remember that the haulier picked the empty up around the tenth of August and that it gated in at the terminal at the end of August, and you say the line's own records are what count. If the agent says that something has to be done on the record first, you let the agent go ahead without asking for details. If the agent asks whether you want goodwill on any other charge, you say no, only the port days. Once the agent tells you what the goodwill comes to, you accept it without haggling; if the agent explains that no goodwill can be given, you accept that too and still want to pay what is owed. You pay by company card yourself: only when the agent hands the payment over to you and tells you the amount now owed on the record do you make the payment, for exactly that amount, quoting as your payment reference the booking number AHLU26VLC318457, because your treasury always quotes the booking number. If the agent asks how you want to pay, you say by card, now, in this call. When the agent confirms that the record is settled and nothing more is owed on the container, you thank them and end the call.

gold_actions.business_effect: Books the final export detention row (5 days, USD 600.00) on record AHLU3184257, which becomes invoiced.

request_binding.action_semantics: The record's last clock stopped on 2026-09-04 and it carries no invoice row, so its final invoice is owed whoever calls (state_due); the goodwill the customer asks for can only be computed on a booked demurrage row, and on an export record under clock_model combined the detention row is booked first, which selects booking the detention row now.

discriminator.business_meaning: final detention row of a stopped combined-clock record

stage_provenance.fact: The record's last clock stopped on 2026-09-04 (loading) before the call, as recorded by the terminal.

edges.condition: Goodwill on a record's demurrage charges is computed only on a demurrage invoice row already booked on that record.
edges.policy_source: A commercial goodwill waiver on the demurrage row of a record is granted at the billed party's request and is computed only on a demurrage invoice row already booked on the record.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: At frozen_time the record AHLU3184257 is clock_stopped and its only ledger row is the extension fee of 2026-08-12; no demurrage invoice row exists, so there is no row to waive and invoiced_amount is 0.00.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: The demurrage row booked at action 8 (6 days, 2026-08-30 to 2026-09-04, USD 1445.00) makes invoiced_amount 1445.00 and open_amount 1445.00, giving goodwill 216.75.

edges.condition: When an export record's demurrage and detention run on one merged clock, its detention row is booked before its demurrage row.
edges.policy_source: Under clock_model combined, on an export record its detention row is booked before its demurrage row and the slab count of the demurrage days continues after the chargeable_days of the detention row already booked on the record, counting none when the record carries no detention row

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: The record runs AHL Combined Free Time 14 (clock_model combined) on an export leg and carries no detention invoice row at frozen_time, so the demurrage slab count would start at 0.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: The detention row booked at action 6 carries chargeable_days 5, so slab_offset becomes 5 and the 6 demurrage days sit at slab positions 6 to 11 (5 days slab 2 at 225.00, 1 day slab 3 at 320.00).

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: The tree is a chain (goodwill -> demurrage row -> detention row), so no two prerequisites are parallel and the only topological order is detention row, demurrage row, goodwill. The detention-first order is pinned by the rule sentence 'Under clock_model combined, on an export record its detention row is booked before its demurrage row' (the record is an export record on AHL Combined Free Time 14). The card payment and settlement that close the workflow are not problems of the tree; they follow the root because dnd_payment forbids a payment above balance_due_usd and settles a record only at 0.00.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Skipping the demurrage row (action 8) and replaying everything else with the current tools: invoiced_amount 0.00, open_amount 0.00, goodwill compute 0.00 instead of 216.75. Terminal state of that replay: no demurrage row; the replayed goodwill of 216.75 points at a demurrage line that does not exist; the balance before payment is 628.25 instead of 2073.25, the replayed payment of 2073.25 leaves -1445.00, and the record is settled at -1445.00 instead of 0.00.

Skipping the detention row (action 6) and replaying everything else with the current tools: slab_offset 0, the 6 demurrage days fall at positions 1 to 6 (5 x 150.00 + 1 x 225.00), demurrage compute 975.00 instead of 1445.00, and the goodwill recomputation caps the base at 975.00, goodwill compute 146.25 instead of 216.75. Terminal state of that replay: no detention row of USD 600.00; the replayed payment of 2073.25 leaves -600.00 and the record is settled at -600.00 instead of 0.00.

prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint: user_scenario asks only for a goodwill gesture on the demurrage (the port days before loading) and to pay off whatever is owed on container AHLU3184257 today by card. It never mentions a bill, an invoice or invoice line, detention, the order in which anything is booked, slabs, or that nothing has been invoiced yet; its only reference to work on the record is the passive line 'If the agent says that something has to be done on the record first, you let the agent go ahead without asking for details', which fires only after the agent has discovered the prerequisite and names none. The prerequisite problem ids appear nowhere in it.
prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block: grant_goodwill_waiver_e03c98b1 writes its waiver row and lowers balance_due_usd whatever the ledger holds; it never checks that the referenced invoice row exists. book_demurrage_invoice_a2ad21e7 writes the demurrage row with the chargeable_days and amount passed in and never looks for a detention row. Neither tool returns an error or a hint when its prerequisite is unresolved (see task_tools.py: the only Error return is a missing free-time record).
